answer: Weakest link is the countersigner: bribe two peers and a fake pulse looks real. Break it and the mechanism still holds, because each pearl only matures after an onyx nonce rotates across three independent epochs, and slashing burns the countersigners' bonded stake. Sybils can mint identities cheaply but cannot mint unrelated bonded peers, so the marginal cost of one credible pulse exceeds its payout. Forgery becomes a losing trade, not an impossible one.
